senses.gloss: c. (חתל b. h. to tie around, swaddle) wrapper of reed-matting in which dates are packed, bale.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 4</cite> <he>ח׳ של וכ׳</he> a mat for dates which is intended to be thrown away when the dates are eaten.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:5">Kel. XVI, 5</cite> <he>ח׳ שהוא וכ׳</he> a bale which you can add to or take from (without cutting it open) &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:11:5">Y. Sabb. I, end, 4ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ שהוא מלא וכ׳</he> a bale filled with fruit stones.

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:2">Ukts. II, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00498"><he>חוֹתָם</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 8:8:2">Y. Keth. VIII, 32ᵇ</cite> top <he>מלא חותלה אסי וכ׳</he>, read <he>ר׳ אסי וכ׳</he>, <he>חותל …</he>]—Pl. <he>חוֹתָלוֹת</he>.
